notes: Original Innersloth assets; game engine and economy implementation are browser recreations.
World draw rectangles use a 96x112 crew body rendered at [-48,-108] relative to its foot anchor. Draw hats/visors with actor head bob; skins with body bob.
Native source names/costs match the archived game and wiki snapshot; wiki availability may differ across versions. No real-money commerce.
35 skins include native idle and twelve original walk overlays aligned using original mesh origin and the same body transform. Remaining five catalog skins use their static original cosmetic art.
Hats, visors and pets use original standalone art with manually calibrated attachment rectangles. Five skin entries use static art; other35 have native walking overlays.
